_note: Coach-profile portraits for the site's manager avatars (docs/app.js -> buildPortraitIndex). Keys are group_id, then manager_id (the stable join key from groups/<group>/config.json — NOT display_name). Values are paths relative to this folder. A manager listed here renders their portrait; anyone absent renders the initials disc, and a listed-but-missing file falls back to initials too. This file is the only place a portrait is wired in — the engine never reads or writes it.
_adding_a_group: Copy the image files into assets/portraits/<group_id>/, then add one line per manager below. Filenames are free-form; the manifest is what maps them. Keep the extension honest (.png vs .jpg) — a wrong extension is served with the wrong type and falls back to initials.
